question: A 28-year-old man is brought to the emergency department by ambulance after being hit in the head with a baseball bat. Physical examination shows swelling and bruising around the left temple and eye. A CT scan of the head shows a transverse fracture through the sphenoid bone and blood in the sphenoid sinus. Neurological examination is most likely to show which of the following findings?

options.opb: Inward deviation of the left eye
options.opd: Decreased hearing in the left ear
options.ope: Deviation of uvula to the right
